Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import pyaudio
import asyncio
import websockets

async def stream_audio():
    # Initialize PyAudio
    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()

    # Open microphone stream
    stream = p.open(format=pyaudio.paInt16, channels=1, rate=16000, input=True, frames_per_buffer=1024)

    # Connect to Google Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming API
    uri = "wss://speech.googleapis.com/v1/speech:streamingRecognize"
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"}
    async with websockets.connect(uri, extra_headers=headers) as websocket:
        # Start streaming recognition request
        request = {
            "config": {
                "encoding": "LINEAR16",
                "sample_rate_hertz": 16000,
                "language_code": "en-US",
                "speech_contexts": [{"phrases": ["hello", "world"]}]
            },
            "interim_results": True
        }
        await websocket.send(str(request))

        # Stream audio and receive interim transcripts

            audio_data = stream.read(1024)

                break

                print(transcript)

    stream.close()
